notes: John O'Reilly's Compose Multiplatform sample for the Climate TRACE emissions data. All eleven @Preview functions live in :composeApp's commonMain and come from org.jetbrains.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview, not the AndroidX one, so they have no Android context to render in and need the desktop/Skiko lane — hence renderer: desktop. :composeApp declares compose.components.uiToolingPreview and a desktop target (compose.desktop.currentOs), which is what that lane needs. Every preview is self-contained: each builds its own Country / rankings values and calls a stateless composable, so none of them touch Koin, the repository or the network — which is what makes this importable at all, and is the difference from :androidApp, whose only preview renders the whole App(). The build asks for a Java 24 toolchain, which the runner does not carry, so javaVersion names it and the pipeline installs it alongside the JDK 21 the CLI runs on.
